reuse.why: Calls the existing link.ensureAccountNotLinked, link.findOrCreateBank, bankSync.syncAccount and handleSyncResponse, but the upgrade-or-create account body and the download function are copied from sibling providers rather than shared.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount repeats the linkAkahuAccount/linkEnableBankingAccount upgrade/insert/sync/notify body almost line for line, and downloadFintegraTransactions repeats downloadEnableBankingTransactions.

placement.why: Each piece lands where its provider siblings live: link handler in accounts/app.ts, download in accounts/sync.ts dispatch, URL in server-config.ts, types in types/models.

scope.why: Only the Fintegra provider plumbing is added.

maintainability.why: Consistent with the existing per-provider convention and easy to read, but adds a sixth copy of the link and download logic that every future linking change must touch.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses ensureAccountNotLinked and findOrCreateBank; no shared link-account abstraction exists to bypass.

disguised_duplication.where: The copies are compacted (single-line throws/insertPayee) but keep the same structure and names; plain duplication.
